summary: The root يمن (ymn) primarily refers to the right side or the south. It also signifies a covenant or oath, often made by God.
lane: اليَمِينُ ذ The location that is on the right. -b2- يَمِينٌ also, The south. See سَرْحٌ . -b3- يَمِينُ also signifies A covenant (Bd, and Jel in lxviii. 39) confirmed by an oath. (Bd, ibid.) يَمِينُ ٱللّٰهِ The oath by attestation of God: see أَيْمُ ٱللّٰهِ , and عَهْدُ ٱللّٰهِ . -b4- حَلَفْتُ يَمِينًا [ I swore, or have sworn, an oath ]. (T, S, M, voce أَمِينٌ , which see. You say, يَمِينَ ٱللّٰهِ لَا أَفْعلُ (as in some copies of the S [meaning, حَلَفْتُ يَمِينَ ٱللّٰهِ ]): or يَمِينُ ٱللّٰهِ (as in other copies [meaning, يَمِينُ ٱللّٰهِ قَسَمِى ]). See a similar form of oath voce حَرَامٌ . -b5- يَمِينًا صَادِقَةً لَأَفْعَلَنَّ : see زَعْمةٌ .

headwords.def: (T, M, K,) and يَمِنَ, (M, K,) He was prosperous; fortunate; lucky. (T, M, K.)
: see 3 in art. شأم in two places.
He made it to incline towards the right: see an ex. voce سِنٌّ (near the end of the paragraph). أَيْمَنَ: see أَشْأَمَ in two places. أَيْمَنْتُ إِبِلِى: see أَيْسَرْتُ.

He was placed on his right side in the grave. (TA, voce عَلْبَى.) تَيَمَّنَ بِهِ i. q. تَبَرَّكَ بِهِ [q. v.]. (S.) فُلَانٌ يُتَيَمَّنُ بِرَأْيِهِ, i. e. يُتَبَرَّكُ بِهِ, (T,) app. One is fortunate in, or derives a blessing from, his counsel. He augured good by it, or from it; or looked for good fortune, or a blessing, from it; syn. تَبَّرَكَ بِهِ: (Mgh, Msb, &c:) opposed to تَشَأءَمَ بِهِ, in the K, art. طير; and in Bd, xvii. 14; and well known.
: see تَشََّامَ. تَيَامَنُوا: see 3 in art. يسر.
Prosperity; good fortune; good luck; auspiciousness; (T, S, M, K;) contr. of شُؤْمٌ, (M,) and of نَحْسٌ. (L, art. سعد.)
: its pl. seems to be يُمَنٌ. See بُرْدٌ.

The location that is on the right. يَمِينٌ also, The south. See سَرْحٌ. يَمِينُ also signifies A covenant (Bd, and Jel in lxviii. 39) confirmed by an oath. (Bd, ibid.) يَمِينُ ٱللّٰهِ The oath by attestation of God: see أَيْمُ ٱللّٰهِ, and عَهْدُ ٱللّٰهِ. حَلَفْتُ يَمِينًا [ I swore, or have sworn, an oath ]. (T, S, M, voce أَمِينٌ, which see.
A garment of Yemen: see a verse voce تَسْهِيمٌ.

[The right, as opposed to the left; see Kur, xix. 53, xx. 82, and xxviii. 30:] contr. of أَيْسَرُ; and [in like manner] is contr. of مَيْسَرَةٌ. (S.) أَيْمَنُ, contr. of أَشْأَمُ, as signifying The right, opposed to the left: and as signifying Lucky, or auspicious: pl. أَيَامِنُ. See أَشْأَمُ. It is also used in the sense of يُمْنٌ: see أَشْأَمُ. Also More, and most, lucky, or auspicious, or happy: see 8 in art. فئل.
used only in swearing, is a sing. noun, not a particle, nor pl. of يَمِينٌ: and is derived from يُمْنٌ. (Mughnee.)
: see an ex. of this word, voce ثَابِرٌ.
The right wing of an army. See أَيْمَنُ.
Fortunate; happy; (T, M, MA, KL;) blest. (T.) See an ex. voce عَرِيكَةٌ.
The having [or receiving ] a blessing. (K L.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
